Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/foursquare/fsq-os-places
Documentation: https://docs.foursquare.com/data-products/docs/access-fsq-os-places

Used by Final Meal for the place search list (public.places rows with source 'fsq'),
imported by scripts/import-places.mjs.

Note: the text above is the copyright and license notice published on Foursquare's
documentation page. The dataset's own README and NOTICE are behind a Hugging Face login;
when the real extract is generated (needs HF_TOKEN), compare this file with the NOTICE
shipped in the dataset and replace it with the dataset's text if it differs.
